dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Three prominent 'O' and 'C' shaped structures on the posterior-lateral surface exhibit irregular, serrated outer perimeters. The gradient transition from low-intensity dark pixels to high-intensity light pixels is sharp, characterized by jagged, non-linear boundaries with frequent pixel-level indentations.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: A high spatial density of localized, asymmetrical clusters of high-intensity light-grey pixels is concentrated along the upper dorsal ridge. These clusters lack internal gradients and vary in form from thin, elongated streaks to compact, multi-sided polygons.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the three largest macro-annuli on the right side form a scalene triangle. Connecting these to the centroids of two vertically aligned blobs in the central-left region creates an irregular pentagonal geometric relationship.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A distinct, small, circular patch with a high-intensity pale core is visible on the proximal dorsal surface of the left hind flipper, appearing as a focal interruption of the typical skin texture.
other_distinctive_markers: The surface displays a dense, reticulated lattice pattern where high-intensity filaments frequently interconnect the larger blobs and rings, creating a complex web-like topology.
